source.note: Downloaded forecast; provider model issuance time is unavailable. Weather uses a nearby model grid cell; elevation is provider terrain metadata.

assumptions: Each time marks the start of a one-hour interval in UTC. Open-Meteo's preceding-hour mean radiation timestamp is shifted back one hour.
Temperature, humidity, wind and cloud cover are provider samples at the end of each interval.
Cloud cover percentages are forecast grid-cell coverage. Missing cloud data remains unavailable; individual rendered cloud shapes and positions are illustrative.
This is a saved forecast projection, not observed weather or a historical backtest.
The forecast begins at 23:00 UTC before the provider's first forecast date. Eleven downloaded days support ten simulation days plus one day of planning.
Shortwave radiation is global horizontal irradiance; panel tilt, shading, snow and equipment temperature effects require additional models.
